Summary: KNOWLEDGE: clinical-trial sponsorship from ClinicalTrials.gov (LEAD_SPONSOR_OF_CLINICAL_TRIAL), admitted only on an exact legal-name match to an already-resolved entity
Description: 1) Original intent: KNOWLEDGE has no admitted relationship type. The Founder ratified (2026-10-12) clinical-trial sponsorship as a candidate for healthcare companies, not to be generalized to subjects without defensible source coverage. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) a new ratified type LEAD_SPONSOR_OF_CLINICAL_TRIAL: part = (sponsor entity node, trial node NCT:<registry id>); evidence: the NCT id, title, overall status and the dates as the registry states them; nu_state {status}; (b) the sponsor is the lead sponsor of the study AND its name with legal suffixes removed equals the already-resolved entity's name (the entity itself was resolved by SEC CIK first; the registry sponsor is matched to it, never used to create identity); a sponsor that does not match exactly is not admitted; (c) only industry lead sponsors; collaborators are not admitted; (d) the newest studies (cap stated, total reported) so formation and counts stay legible; (e) runs through the existing path for any resolved entity and yields nothing, stated as none found, for companies with no studies; (f) verified live for Boston Scientific and a company with none; existing counts unchanged. 3) Current implementation state: ratified 2026-10-12; starting. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1411 (producer contracts), KRYL-1402, KRYL-1398. 5) Superseded: no. 6) Maps to the product model: yes (KNOWLEDGE).
